scores.tell: Planet has a small sharp highlight top-left and dark lower core shadow; slightly strong but close to real cards.
Wagon has soft, gentle shading, but its contact shadows and cloth highlights are a bit uniform and painterly.
Calculator has smooth bevelled forms and soft key highlights. Rim glints on the edges are slightly plasticky.
Moon base has flat, even light with a weak form turn. Its glass dome has hard banded stripes, and the shadows are faint.
Sleeping bag has a soft, smooth form turn and a gentle sheen. The belly bounce is slightly airbrushed.
House has flat, painterly light with little form modeling. The stone walls are patchy, and the cast shadow on the grass is weak.
Backpack has glossy, rounded blobby forms with strong soft highlights. It is slightly too inflated and glossy.
Lifeguard chair has flat, broad planes with little core shadow. The chair legs are thin and show almost no cast shadow.
Spotlight has a clean metallic sheen and a dark body. The truss highlights are a bit sharp and the beam is airbrushed.
Asteroid has soft clay-like modeling with a smooth turn. The crater shading is slightly over-textured.
